description: %Pt{x: 1, y: 2} == %{__struct__: Pt, x: 1, y: 2} is true; compare_values (ir_runtime.rs:2700) and the map hash read through the layout-blind view. A value prints as %Name{...} exactly when its __struct__ names a struct whose schema the runtime holds and its keys are exactly that schema's fields; otherwise it prints as a map (Elixir oracle confirmed). Oracle fixtures on all three paths.
title: Equality, ordering and printing of a struct are layout-blind
